visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight dark hair and full bangs is positioned in the center of the frame against a backdrop of light beige curtains. She wears a black lace camisole, her face and shoulders clearly visible. She looks directly at the camera with a neutral but soft facial expression, her mouth slightly parted. She raises her right hand towards the lens, pinching her thumb and index finger together in a small gesture. (2) The woman moves her hand rapidly toward the camera lens, causing the fingers to become extremely blurred as they cover the majority of the frame, momentarily obscuring her face except for her forehead. The background remains the same neutral curtain, and the lighting is soft and even across her skin. (3) She holds her hand close to the lens and slowly separates her thumb and index finger horizontally, creating a narrow gap that functions as a frame. Through this frame, her eyes are revealed in an extreme close-up, looking steadily and intently into the camera. She blinks occasionally, and the focus remains on the clarity of her iris and the dark eyeliner at the corners of her eyes.
